|game_text=May deploy Shada and [Virtual Set 15] No Bargain instead of Xizor with your [Reflections2] objective. While that Effect on table, Force loss from your [Reflections2] objective is +1 and, once per turn, may lose 1 Force to add a battle destiny anywhere. Immune to attrition < 4.
|printings={{Card versions/Shada}}
|notes=The printed setup names the Galactic Frontier No Bargain and the Reflections II Objective. The launch ruling makes the related Effect part of the Shada setup. If it cannot deploy, Shada returns to the deck and the player must deploy Xizor. If Xizor cannot deploy, the Objective goes out of play, its deployed cards return to Reserve Deck, and play begins without that Objective or starting location. Other ways of deploying Shada do not bring out No Bargain through this rule. The two printed Warrior icons allow two weapons.
